application_review: PROGRESS. The preceding bounded-diagonal round was rechecked before edits. Retained source hashes and axiom sets are unchanged.

The finite-mass multiplication bound uses the original nonnegative coefficients and the actual L2 seminorm. The linear multiplier acts on L2-bounded families without requiring a pointwise bound on its input.

Hilbert distance contraction follows from the actual coordinate norm-square limits; the inner-product symmetry is proved from the original weighted expectations. This respects zero-distance identification without postulating a product on arbitrary Hilbert vectors.

For cellwise mixed-dual-hull multipliers, generator preservation follows from exact hull multiplication. Scaled-hull representatives remain in the algebraic span, and contraction extends preservation to represented members of the closed dual space.
Pairing symmetry and generator preservation prove preservation of the actual orthogonal complement by span induction and closure.

Projection uniqueness gives the pull-out identity when an actual representative of the projected input is supplied. The preceding exact-model theorem provides such representatives for unit-interval inputs under its tail-containing-ultrafilter hypotheses.

Eight theorems and one linear-map definition are audited. No commutation between different subgroup projections, full conditional-expectation factor identification, characteristic-factor localization, or high-order concatenation/Bessel is inferred.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional mixed Gowers Cauchy-Schwarz, the product-root bound and the single-vertex bound are now proved. Actual dual anti-uniformity, its weighted version and the finite zero-root orthogonality characterization are now proved. Mixed dual recursion, covariance and exact subgroup-shift expansions are now established. Same-subgroup mixed-dual finite products now have an exact averaged dual representation and retain weighted anti-uniformity. The actual unit-input mixed-dual convex hull now has multiplicative and translation closure with unchanged weighted anti-uniform bounds. For varying finite groups and cell types, the exact weighted Haar Hilbert realization and vanishing-Gowers/closed-dual-span orthogonality equivalence are now proved. The dual Hilbert span now has uniformly bounded scaled-hull representatives dense in its closure; their bound may depend on the approximation. Fixed-polynomial and continuous functional calculus for scaled-hull representatives, their clipping closure, and unit-interval-valued approximation of the actual dual Hilbert projection are now proved. The actual dual projection now controls the limiting Gowers power and yields unit-interval models with arbitrarily small Gowers error along the same ultrafilter. For ultrafilters containing every tail, diagonalization now provides one exact unit-interval representative of the dual projection and residual Gowers convergence to zero. Actual unit mixed-dual-hull multiplication now preserves the closed dual space and its orthogonal complement and satisfies the genuine projection pull-out identity on represented inputs. Higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
